documents.title: Ibuprofen and gastrointestinal bleeding in adults: a randomised trial
documents.text:
PubMed — PMID 35991234 — "Ibuprofen and gastrointestinal bleeding in adults: a randomised trial"
(Scandinavian Journal of Gastroenterology, 2023).

METHODS: 1,204 adults aged 18-65 years with osteoarthritis were randomised to ibuprofen 800 mg
three times daily or paracetamol for 12 weeks.
RESULTS: Major gastrointestinal bleeding occurred in 9 participants (1.5%) in the ibuprofen group
versus 2 (0.3%) in the paracetamol group (risk ratio 4.4, 95% CI 1.0-20.1).
CONCLUSIONS: In adults, high-dose ibuprofen increased the risk of major gastrointestinal bleeding.
Children were not included in this trial.

evidence.quote: In adults, high-dose ibuprofen increased the risk of major gastrointestinal bleeding.
